about.metaDescription: Husan Suyunov — Full-Stack Python Developer. Django, FastAPI, React, LMS/CRM systems, AI and Telegram bots.
about.title: About me
about.p1: Hi! I'm Husan Suyunov, a Full-Stack Python Developer. I build web applications, LMS and CRM systems end-to-end — backend and frontend — with Python, Django, FastAPI and React. AI projects (NLP, Machine Learning) and Telegram bots are also among my core areas.
about.p2: As head of the IT Park Zaamin district branch, I work on digitalizing the learning process: itclms.uz, the ITC Academy platform and its Telegram bot are results of this work. I study Business Management in Networks at Kimyo International University in Tashkent, so I look at projects from both a technical and a business perspective.
about.p3: Learning new technologies and finding innovative solutions to complex problems are my top priorities. The code of all my projects is open on GitHub.
